run_BERT_reranker_training: run the BERT reranker training loop on AIDA entity linking data with gradient accumulation
run_model_evaluation: run evaluation of the trained reranking model on pregenerated candidate sets
run_training_with_debug: run the reranker training in debug mode using only 200 samples
run_full_evaluation: run evaluation of the trained model on all benchmark datasets
run_training_with_custom_bert: run the reranker training with a custom pretrained BERT model and learning rate
